column1: # Native components that ship inside the APK.
# These are not Maven artefacts, so neither Licensee nor the Gradle dependency
# graph sees them: this file is the checked-in record, and
# scripts/check-native-licences.sh verifies it against the licence texts in
# app/src/main/assets/licenses/ (what Settings → About shows) and against NOTICE
# (what the repository carries), plus the version each component's source of
#   component <TAB> version-source <TAB> licence-asset <TAB> upstream <TAB> SPDX id
# version-source is `<file>:<KEY>` (the value that pins the version) or
# `binary` when the version comes from the shipped library itself.
